card.name: Pr- start of prince-like words
card.fires_on: The fragment "Pr" at the start of a capitalized word in non-medical text, especially when it begins a word for prince, principality, Prussia or primitive. It also fires weakly on similar word starts such as "C" in Corgi.

modes.label: Pr- opening title words
modes.description: "Pr" starts a foreign or capitalized word meaning prince or principality, or a related place name.

modes.label: Pr- in Latin or other words
modes.description: "Pr" or "PR" starts a Latin, French or all-caps word such as primum, primitive or Prévost.

card.writes: It pushes toward words for royalty such as queen, king and royal, so it helps predict royal-themed word continuations.
card.plain: It lights up on the opening letters "Pr" of words like Prince or Prussia in history text.
